key_insight: O-kRystal learns momentum-resolved orbital corrections from low-cost PBE inputs to predict higher-fidelity electronic band structures beyond standard DFT.
engineering_relevance: This enables faster, more accurate band-structure and density-of-states predictions for screening materials with insulating, metallic, magnetic, and correlated behavior.
method: Uses PBE band energies as a baseline.
Adds real-space and reciprocal-space orbital matrices as structured inputs.
Predicts state-specific HSE06 or G0W0 corrections across crystal momentum and spin.
evidence_signal: Across nearly 6,000 3D materials, it achieves 0.171 ± 0.009 eV MAE for states within 5 eV of the band-edge midpoint and also generalizes to unseen band-path points; on six correlated materials it reduces PBE band-energy MAE by 68.7%.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and coverage of the training level-of-theory data and may require careful transfer checks when moving to new chemistries or lower-symmetry systems.
paper_title: Beyond DFT electronic band structures via dual-space orbital learning
